Olivia: Quick flag — saw ~22 webinar leads created in HubSpot that landed as owner=unassigned. SDRs report missing company/name after enrichment timeout.
Ben: Did we flip the new enrichment lambda yesterday?
Saanvi: Yes, rolled at 07:30. Vendor returned intermittent 504s. HubSpot workflow treats that as 'done' with blanks, which triggers RR.
Olivia: That explains the blank records. Can we gate RR for short window instead of immediately routing?
Ben: Suggestion: set `rr_hold_ts` on create and only allow RR if enrichment_status==complete OR now() - rr_hold_ts > 30s. Minimal change in router.
Saanvi: We can feature-flag router debounce and log `rr.skip=hold` with vendor tag. Roll to 5% regionally first.
Nina: SDR ops: if you add a saved view `hs:rr_hold`, we'll pause outreach until enrichment completes. I'll draft a one-liner for SDRs.
eng-bot: DEPLOY 1748804335 - router-debounce feature flag enabled for us-west-1 5% by Saanvi.
Ben: Metrics to watch: marketing.handoff.unassigned_rate, sdr.manual_backfill_count, enrichment.vendor.latency_p95.
Olivia: Action list: Saanvi deploy flag + logs (ETA now), Nina create SDR view + note (ETA 1h), Ben add metrics to dashboard (ETA EOD). If canary looks good, widen globally. Thanks :thumbsup:
